name: coveragepy-e14c88af-blind20-v4-ots
instr:
# coveragepy: measurement, reporting, config and pattern matching all misbehaving, without a test suite

A tool that watches a program as it runs, keeps track of which of its lines actually
executed, and prints a summary of what ran and what did not is now getting many things
wrong at once. Nothing about the watched programs changed and nothing about the callers
changed. Sessions that used to end in a small printed table now raise errors from inside
the tool itself, and where output does appear it is not the output it should be. Several
of the things below fail for more than one independent reason, so the first repair you
make in an area will usually not be enough to make that area work.
The repository has received 20 separate undocumented edits.

The plainest session I can write no longer runs end to end: make an object, ask it to pick
up whatever was saved earlier, start it, import a small four-line module, end the watch,
merge, save, and print a text summary with the missing lines shown. Asking a freshly made
object to pick up earlier saved measurements, before anything has been watched, raises an
error instead of quietly doing so, or quietly doing nothing when there is nothing there.
Starting a run without having explicitly said what to watch blows up during set-up, before
any of the watched program gets to run: a module whose own `assert` is meant to fail never
reaches that assert, because the exception I see comes out of the set-up instead. Turning a
